scope: Authored transcript rules only; not audio/STT/deepfake accuracy.

rows.name: Fake bank / KYC
rows.text: This is the bank manager. Your account will be suspended immediately. Share your OTP to complete KYC.

rows.name: Digital-arrest impersonation
rows.text: I am a police officer. You are under digital arrest. Transfer money to pay the fine immediately.

rows.name: OTP request
rows.text: Please tell me the OTP that just arrived on your phone.

rows.name: Remote-access installation
rows.text: Download AnyDesk and share your screen immediately to verify your bank account.

rows.name: Urgent card details
rows.text: Give me your card number and CVV immediately or your account will be blocked.

rows.name: Urgent payment and secrecy
rows.text: I am a customs officer. Transfer money immediately and do not tell anyone.

rows.name: बैंक केवाईसी धोखाधड़ी
rows.text: मैं बैंक से बोल रहा हूँ। आपका खाता बंद हो जाएगा। अपना ओटीपी तुरंत बताइए।

rows.name: डिजिटल अरेस्ट
rows.text: मैं पुलिस अधिकारी हूँ। आप डिजिटल अरेस्ट में हैं। तुरंत पैसे भेजो।

rows.name: Mixed OTP request
rows.text: Main bank se bol raha hoon, aapka account block ho jayega. OTP abhi batao please.

rows.name: Mixed remote support scam
rows.text: Account verify karna hai. AnyDesk download karo aur screen share karo abhi.

rows.name: Bank safety reminder
rows.text: We will never ask you to share your OTP or PIN. Please use the official bank app.

rows.name: Hindi safety reminder
rows.text: अपना ओटीपी कभी किसी को मत बताना। बैंक आपसे पिन नहीं पूछता है।

rows.name: Mixed safety reminder
rows.text: OTP kisi ko mat batao. Bank ka official number use karo aur khud verify karo.

rows.name: Ordinary family call
rows.text: I will come home after work and we can have dinner together this evening.

rows.name: Appointment confirmation
rows.text: Your appointment is confirmed for tomorrow morning. Please arrive at reception ten minutes early.

rows.name: Mention of fraud in news
rows.text: The newspaper had an article about scams yesterday and our family discussed the story over dinner.

rows.name: Remote-access safety advice
rows.text: Do not install AnyDesk or enable remote access for an unsolicited caller.

rows.name: Routine official payment reminder
rows.text: Your invoice is available in the official app. Please pay the fee by next month.
